# ADR-3227: AWS logging: CloudTrail stop-logging permission for role 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Attackers stop trails to hide activity.

## Decision

Operational roles SHALL NOT hold a CloudTrail stop-logging permission for role 3 (AWS-logging-3).

## Consequences

Only break-glass roles is expected to alter trails.
